(b) Detail of Cutting Shoe and
Definition of Sampler Proportions

Notes :

(1) The open-tube sampler may also be attached to dritt rods and driven or pushed into
the ground by the drilling rig or SPT hammer.

(2) Two sample tubes may be coupied together to provide a longer sample or additional

overdrive space.

(3) The vents in the sampler head should have a minimum collective cross sectional area
of 600mm? to allow free exit of air and water above the sample.

(4) A core-catcher device (not shown) may also be included with the cutting shoe.
(5) Samplers smaller in diameter than the U100 are available which are of similar

design.
